question: How does ordinary experience become effortless worship of the supreme powers?
premises: Absorption in true being follows the self.
That absorption supports the rite of worship of the wheel of supreme Kula powers.
Through this, experience naturally becomes an instrument without effort.
inference: When grounded in absorption in true being, experience effortlessly becomes worship of the supreme powers.
plain_english: Resting on absorption in true being that follows the self, one naturally and without effort comes to function as an instrument in the worship of the wheel of the supreme Kula lord and his powers.
